requirement.criterion: The close reconciles cash, card terminal and transfers against recorded payments.

auditScope: Authorized repository only, read before implementation; no provider/database/browser/Git mutation.

facts: Front desk counts cash after last class and compares payments they recorded; pending transfers go to finance.
Finance reconciles closing sheet, payment log and Wompi; cash expenses enter till closing but front desk/coordinator cannot read expenses.
Wompi matched to sale date, not deposit date; settlement cycle/account are pending.
Manual says terminal confirmed by Wompi, unlike current S04 card/manual mapping.
cash_difference_threshold is unresolved template token; no fixed closing hour/window/signoff/reopen contract identified.

Existing /staff/register route permits super_admin/admin/coordinator/front_desk; actual payments.write early guard permits panel only super_admin/admin/front_desk, preserving coordinator noPermission.
Only Wompi link is pending; other current desk methods locally approved. Pending links still contain amount_paid although paid_at is null.
Different amount_paid is allowed with observation; amount is invoiced total.
No settlement date, close batch, opening float, cash movement ledger or per-refund amount/date contract.
Review sets taken_by to reviewer; this is attribution, not proof of original creator/collector.
Approved transfer requires exact payment amount and sets paid_at; rejection can have amount_paid but no paid_at.
Existing rolling range uses paid_at fallback created_at, approved amount totals, method grouping without provider distinction.
Finance route is admin/super/finance, not Reception; do not expand it.
Refund flips status but preserves original amount_paid; no actual refund amount/date or net-cash proof.

safeSlice: Contained S04 browser-only count draft/preview, existing actual payments.write gate.
Read only exact tenant/current actor taken_by payment rows and own active account; no customer/profile/expense/invoice/ledger joins.
Expose exact method/provider/status/currency references; no guessed terminal confirmation or Wompi settlement.
Separate created_at record-day and paid_at confirmation-day using studio calendar labels; no fallback for missing timestamps.
Reference amount and amount_paid independently; unknown/missing values never become zero; unresolved overall expected/net/closed/reconciled totals withheld.
Neutral initially blank cash/card-manual/transfer-manual counted COP fields; explicit preview/save/cancel/discard; browser-only actor/role/tenant/day scoped revision/request replay.
No provider writes, real close, adjustments, message dispatch or cross-device/cross-tab transaction guarantee.
unresolvedOwnerGates: Approved accounting amount basis, staff attribution/scope, close cutoff/shift ownership, opening float/withdrawals and expense treatment without broadening access.
Difference threshold/escalation, signature/signoff/reopen and refund/netting policy; old no-refunds versus future PG11/FI01 remains unresolved.
backendGates: Authenticated scoped authoritative reconciliation/immutable close and audit; bank/provider settlement and durable storage.
classification: Original PG12 remains unaccepted/Not verified; this audit does not promote implementation status.
